steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: ...Anything interesting going on, Aosta?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Wait, no, Aosta's out in the field.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I'm bored. Why won't anything interesting happen?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Got any ideas, Broca?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Hm.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: ...What day of the week is it again?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Tuesday.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I'm done. Heading back.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: It's Wednesday, though. Something's going on with him.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: He's hiding something from me.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Now THAT is something interesting.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I should see what he's up to—

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: No, he wouldn't tell me if I asked. What I should do is—

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: There.
Broca's room is not particularly tidy for an operator.
Not that it is exceptionally messy, but it is filled with things. Parts, plans, and tools are scattered over the floor, on the desk, and even on the bed.
It is more workshop than dorm room.
Most prominent is the workbench in a corner.
Broca had earned recognition for his skills after joining Rhodes Island, and the Engineering Department had prepared a work area for him in its workshop.
But he turned the offer down, preferring to work in his own room.
So the Engineering Department instead provided him with a workbench and soundproofed his room.
Normally, Broca gets straight to work after returning to his room.
But he does not do so today, instead sitting on his chair and taking a look around the desk.
Numerous designs have been placed around the desk, all depicting his multi-function drill.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: It's so hard to give up on any of these designs—

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: But I just got some new ideas today. I should make a few more versions.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Alright, let's get to work—

steps.name: Communications Announcement
steps.text: Operator Broca, please report to the Engineering Department immediately.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: The Engineering Department? Did they finally get those materials I asked for?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I should go check.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Bravo, got him out of the way.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: If Aosta were here, he'd shake his head over how simple-minded the guy is.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: But I don't think being simple is so bad.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Alright, now, let's see what he was up to behind my back.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Huh? What's with these designs—

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Ooh, this drill can be extended. Nice.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: But I think I prefer the one with built-in speakers that can play heavy metal.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Mamma mia! This one's a masterpiece! It transforms from a drill to a chainsaw! Just like in that video game we played together!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I knew it...

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: It was you!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Welcome back, Broca.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Stop looking at them!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: These plans aren't half bad.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Very creative.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: And here I thought you were hiding in here 'cause you were up to something shady.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I wasn't trying to hide them. It's just that I had a lot of ideas...

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: This drill's been with me since I was in Siracusa. It's like another arm for me.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I just wanted to tinker with it a little.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: So why hide it? Isn't your bro just like your arm either?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: You don't use your bros to hold it steady when you take a leak.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hey, I'm open to that too, just saying.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Seriously, I've thought this through. Once we're real old, we could—

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Vaffanculo.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: What I'm saying is that these are all just whatever dumb ideas came to mind!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I never planned on showing them to anyone!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Does it matter?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Of course it does!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Didn't we swear to keep no secrets between us?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: That's not the same thing! If I wanted to show them to you, I would!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Well, I already saw them.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: And since I have, why not let me help you mod your drill? Aosta's not around and I am SO bored.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Vai a cagare!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hey, open the door, Broca!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: What's the big deal?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I don't get it. Why even hide it? It's just a drill.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Well, I'm not taking no for an answer. Just you wait, Broca!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Okay, back to work.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Damn Chiave, that cretino.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: How am I supposed to focus on the design now?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: That completely killed my mood.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Dammit.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Guess I'll go for a walk. Maybe that'll give me some inspiration.
Whenever Broca has trouble focusing, he comes to the Convalescent Garden that Perfumer tends to.
The pleasant aroma surrounds him the moment he steps in.
He finds a corner to sit down, and then begins to take in the sweet air.
He takes a few breaths, and feels his mind calm down.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: What if, when the drill's spinning—

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Let's make it give off a sweet scent!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: What are you doing here?!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I saw you come this way, so I followed you.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: But I bet you were thinking the same thing, right?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: No, I wasn't.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: But you were talking about the drill, right?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: You heard wrong.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Yeah right. Besides, we're bros. I know you. We were definitely thinking the same thing!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Even if we were, we definitely aren't now!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Why not?!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Because you said it first.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: What? C'mon bro, since when were you so picky? It's not like this is the first time we've modded something together.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: It's not the same, bro.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: This time, I chose to mod it on my own. It's not the same.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Well, what's the difference then?!
The wind is strong on the deck. There are a few operators standing in the distance, but it would be fair to describe this place as 'empty'.
Broca is among those who like to come here at this hour.
He enjoys the emptiness, the solitude.
Of course, he also has another aim today.
He took a dozen different passages, made eight wrong turns, and spent time in six activity rooms before arriving here.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: ...I hope Chiave doesn't show up this time.
Broca stands by the handrails, letting his mind go blank, feeling the wind rip through his hair.
He resolves to think about nothing until dinner.
By then, Chiave should hopefully have given up.
But things rarely go as planned.
A hand taps him on the shoulder.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Why, Chiave?
Chiave is standing behind him, holding several designs in his hand.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I've been thinking, bro. You made so many designs, so I should show you some of mine.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: That's why I drew a couple just now. Wanna take a look?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: That's not what I need, bro.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Then what do you need?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Nothing. I need nothing from you. I just wanna mod this drill on my own, maybe get creative with it.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: That's the part I don't get. Why do you have to do it on your own?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Because—tch, how do I explain it to you?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Just say it. I won't laugh.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: That's not the problem.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: There are just some things I can't say out loud.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Well, how am I supposed to know if you don't tell me?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I'd have thrown you off the deck by now if we weren't bros.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Fine... 'cause I think the designs are nothing special. Like a kid's doodles.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I'm just messing around. It was never meant for anyone else.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: And now you know.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: So that's what this was about.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I knew you lacked confidence, bro, so I guess it's not too surprising.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: But you've been at Rhodes Island for a while now, and everybody here knows what you can do.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Be confident.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: ...That's not really it, but thanks anyway. Don't often get to hear you say something nice like that.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I wasn't done.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Besides, I think your ideas are great!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Which is why I've made up my mind—

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I'll show your designs to the folks in Engineering. Getting their approval would be a huge for you, right?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Wait, that's not...

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Hold it right there, Chiave! I'll skin you alive!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Damn, I'm too late.
The plans on the workbench had disappeared.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I'm gonna request a new lock first thing in the morning, and I'll never give Chiave a spare keycard again!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Where'd he go—

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Oh, right, of course, Engineering! Gotta keep my cool.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Phew—that was a long mission.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Finally, time to relax—

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Aosta! You're back!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Chiave's making a presentation in the Engineering Department. He's telling everyone to stop by.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Vulcan.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Nothing good ever happens when you show up.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hah! I brought lots of interesting designs today.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Look at these—

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Thank goodness, made it in time.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: C'mon, Broca, don't be so shy.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: It's not what you think—

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Stop pretending, I know exactly what you're thinking.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Merda, the hell you do—

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Everyone's gonna see your designs today!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Absolutely not!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Er, what happened?

steps.name: Chiave & Broca
steps.text: Aosta! You're back!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: I came because I heard Chiave was giving some kind of presentation.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: So why does it look like you two are about to start punching each other?

steps.name: Chiave & Broca
steps.text: Listen, Broca/Chiave is—

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Alright, I see what's going on.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: You be the judge, Aosta. Who's in the right here?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: I'll hear you out first, Broca. What do you want here?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Chiave.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I finally get it.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: The only way out of this mess is to beat you up so bad you're stuck in bed for three days.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hmph, getting cocky now, are we?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: You forced my hand.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: You do know what you're saying, don't you?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I'm dead serious.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: ...Alright then, bring it on!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Cazzo!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I didn't do anything to piss Broca off recently, did I?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Does he not want to be bros with us anymore?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: You're overthinking it.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Well, there are a lot of interesting folks on Rhodes Island. If he wants to go solo, I guess I should give him my blessing.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: It's not like that.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: We've come all the way from Siracusa together. I can't let the team fall apart that easily.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: If he's getting any ideas, he's got to beat me first.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: And I'll give it my all to stop him!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Right, Aosta? Why are you giving me that look?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: I'm just thinking that nothing's changed with either you or Broca after all these years.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: That so?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Yeah. Lasagna's on the lunch menu. You wanna fill up?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: I'll get a few more drinks.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hell yeah! Can't beat a bro up on an empty stomach!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: You've eaten, haven't you? I'm not pulling any punches today.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Neither am I.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: There's still time to back out of this.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: No. We're doing this, Chiave.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Because you'd never give up on 'helping' me if we don't, would you?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Of course not! You and Aosta are my bros. I can't just leave you alone.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: You're saying you don't need my help? You don't need your bros anymore?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: ...You and Aosta are still my bros for sure.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Then let us help you!

steps.name: Aosta (In the Distance)
steps.text: Er, could you keep me out of this?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Us being bros has nothing to do with it!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I'm allowed to want to solve my own problems!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: You stubborn cretino!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: You're the stubborn one!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Looks like my fist and my spanner will have to remind you that the Chiave Gang is inseparable!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Then my fist and my drill will have to tell you that even bros need some personal space!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Well, I never needed any, you stronzo!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: But I do!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: What the... my stomach—

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: My stomach... it hurts...

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Aosta... you set me up—

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: ...Sorry, Chiave.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Aosta, is he still angry?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Of course he is, after what you said.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: He even asked me if he pissed you off recently.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: ...*sigh*

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I know he honestly wants to help me.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: That's just the kind of guy he is. Everything he has, he wants to share with the people around him. He doesn't understand that some people need their own alone time.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: He wouldn't be Chiave if he listened.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: True.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Which is why I need your help.
In a corner of the Engineering Department, Chiave lies feebly on a bench, gazing up at the ceiling while holding his stomach, giving the impression that he has never been so bewildered.
Aosta sits by him with a bag in his hands.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Broca got you some medicine from Medical. Take it and you should feel better tomorrow.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Dammit.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I still don't get it.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Shouldn't bros share everything with each other, no matter what?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Bros, lovers, family... Even in relationships like that, people keep secrets from each other.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Sometimes, we even keep secrets from ourselves.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: You might be the only person on Terra who'd ask a question like that.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: So you're keeping things from me too?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Then what do I do? Do I just have to accept it?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Maybe—
In the distance, Broca is standing at the door to an Engineering workshop, ready to go.
He takes one concerned glance towards Aosta and Chiave. Aosta nods to reassure him.
Broca lets out a sigh of relief, then brings his drill into the workshop along with the materials he prepared.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: But maybe sometimes all we have to do is to wait.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Then, we greet our bro with a smile.
